description:
GAOA Bar Island Dam Reconstruction - Notice of Solicitation Number Change for Requirement 140L0626B0004.

This announcement serves to notify all interested parties that the requirement related to 140L0626B0004 is hereby replaced by solicitation number 140L0626R0006.

Effective immediately:
-No further announcements, amendments, or updates will be issued under 140L0626B0004.
-All future communications, including announcements and related information for this requirement, will be posted under 140L0626R0006.

Interested vendors are advised to monitor 140L0626R0006 on SAM.gov for all updates, requirements, and submission details moving forward.

There is no response related to this announcement.
